_comment: The wild population. ALL TUNABLE. Positions are absolute world metres; everything is stood on the ground by asking the world (D09). Tuskroot is deliberately absent: it is the evolved form, only obtainable by evolving a caught Mudsnout (D20). Veridian is the future legendary, also absent.
_comment_placement: The playground is 512m on a side (data/config/terrain_playground.json), so everything here sits well inside +/-256. Water species cluster at the pond valley around [-120, 130]. Galecrest and Burrowback were meant for the rocky rise at [140, -90] itself, but that rise's rim is a closed >45-degree band by design (terrain_playground.json: rises are 'the only places the 45-degree slope limit should actually bite') — measured at 71 of 72 radial approaches unwalkable — so a creature up there can never be met, fought or caught. Both live on the meadow at its southern foot instead: the ambush happens on the approach below the danger ground, not on an unreachable plateau. The Bramblebun cluster's nearest edge stays within ~60m of the origin, because the opening walks a brand-new player out to it.

roles._comment: Species the code and the smoke tests address by ROLE so the table can be retuned without breaking them.
